name: IT桔子
description: Query ITJuzi primary-market structured data for company, funding, investor, and industry-tag research.
description_zh: 通过 IT桔子 MCP 查询公司、融资事件、投资机构、赛道标签等一级市场结构化数据，适合投研问答和行业分析。
description_en: Query ITJuzi primary-market structured data for company, funding, investor, and industry-tag research.
examples_zh: 北京、上海、深圳 2026 年机器人赛道融资总额和事件数对比。
红杉中国最近一年投过哪些人工智能公司？
具身智能标签下，中国公司中哪些已经有对外投资记录，并列出各家的对外投资清单。
examples_en: Compare robotics funding totals and deal counts in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen in 2026.
Which AI companies has Sequoia China invested in over the past year?
List Chinese companies under the embodied AI tag that have outbound investment records, along with their investment cases.
